description: This file contains test cases for the React front-end of a quiz application, specifically testing the 'shuffle' randomness, adaptive mode toggle, accuracy display, and timer-based auto-advance features.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets a fixed seed for deterministic randomness and activates fake timers before each test.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Resets timers and removes the seed after each test to clean up modifications.

methods.name: test('shuffle produces deterministic option order with seeded RNG')
methods.description: Verifies that shuffling options with a fixed seed produces a consistent order across renders.

methods.name: test('adaptive mode toggles label and shows recent accuracy ribbon')
methods.description: Tests toggling adaptive mode and verifies accuracy display updates accordingly.

methods.name: test('adaptive + timer expiry still auto-advances deterministically')
methods.description: Ensures that auto-advancement of questions via timer works predictably in adaptive mode.
